category_title: Adolescents who disengage due to perceived teacher indifference and lack of individual support
minimal_context: The student is attempting to complete a worksheet passed out in the last fifteen minutes of class.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Alright, we have fifteen minutes left in class. I'm passing out the work now, please get started on it.

STUDENT: I'm trying to do it, but I don't understand. Can I get some help?

TUTOR: Just review what we just went over. Give it a try.

STUDENT: You just went on and on talking for the whole period. I still don't get what to do.

TUTOR: I've already helped you once. I can't help you more than that right now.

STUDENT: You didn't help me with anything, so I just stopped doing my work.

options.A: Provide specific praise statements immediately after the student exhibits any positive on-task behavior while attempting to complete the worksheet.
options.B: Issue the sanction of a formal verbal warning to the student for stopping their work during the last fifteen minutes of class.
options.C: Simplify the worksheet instructions, explaining that the student only needs to focus on one specific part of the task right now.
options.D: Provide external regulation to help the student start inhibiting their inappropriate urges to stop working on the assigned worksheet.
